messages:
anya: Quick FYI — I opened a small community PR that adds a tiny `redwood-cli` helper for streaming outputs. CI passes on linux but macos (arm) runner is failing one test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/482

mike: Link saved. Can you paste the failing trace? :mag: 

anya: ci output snippet:
```
Failing test: test_stream_chunking
Expected 3 chunks, got 4
/opt/hostedtoolcache/ruby/3.x/gems/redwood-sdk-0.5.1/spec/stream_spec.rb:42
```
Only happens on macos-latest (macos-arm). linux and macos-x86 are green.

ci-bot: build #482.5 — macos-latest — ❌ failed (flake: test_stream_chunking)

samir: Hmm, could be scheduling/timing jitter on arm VMs. That test sometimes relies on exact sleep windows, right?

anya: Yeah it's asserting exact chunk counts from a fake generator. It uses `sleep 0.02` between chunks.

elaine: For community PRs we prefer not to expand CI matrix coverage unless the change touches native deps. Maybe mark test as timing-tolerant and skip the strict assert on macos-arm. Also add a short note in CONTRIBUTING.md about minimal support for macos-arm flakiness.

mike: I hate skipping, but making the assertion tolerant is better. e.g., assert_includes 3..4 instead of ==3. That preserves behavior but avoids flakes. Also add an env var `FULL_CI_MATRIX=true` to let maintainers opt-in to re-run full matrix for important fixes.

anya: Good plan — I'll update the PR: change assert to range and add a conditional skip for the specific runner as a fallback.

samir: One more thing — while testing I noticed a separate smaller issue: when using `redwood-cli login` with a refreshable token, reconnect streaming sometimes trims `Authorization` header on reconnect causing a brief 401 before retry. I filed https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/issues/731 with logs. Not sure if related to this test but worth tracking.

mike: Nice catch. That one should be low-sev but not lost — add it to the SDK backlog and link to the PR. Might be an auth middleware ordering bug in the streaming reconnect path.

elaine: Agreed. For community contributions we should document minimal-maintenance expectations: we don't guarantee fixing platform-specific CI flakes for third-party PRs, but we will accept small behavior-tolerant patches and help triage security/auth regressions. Add short blurb to CONTRIBUTING.md.

anya: Added commits: `make-stream-test-tolerant` + `contrib: note macos-arm flakiness`. Re-ran CI.

ci-bot: build #482.7 — macos-latest — ✅ passed

mike: :tada: thanks anya. Can you also add a one-line changelog entry for the CLI helper? Keeps community authors happy.

anya: Will do. Thanks for the quick reviews — closing this loop.

samir: TL;DR: prefer tolerant tests over skipping, doc minimal support for macos-arm in community PRs, track auth-reconnect 401 separately.

elaine: Filing a tiny GH meta PR to add the contrib blurb so future PRs have the guidance. :memo:
